CONFIDENTIAL

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No. 3776
Special Branch. S. 3-5 Section.
Date July 1, 1932.）

Subject (in full).................................................... The "Tung Wan Pao"

Made by......... C.A. J.A.Cook, and ......... Forwarded by......... C.D.I. )

Sir,
        The "Tung Wan Pao"(            ) (The Chinese Christian
Intelligencer) a Christian newspaper published weekly at No.19
Yuen Min Yuen Road by the Presbyterian Christian Mission of
the United States of America operating in China, which forms
the subject of the attached report by D.S. M.Umemoto, has been
in existence for almost thirty years.    Until the first week
of February of the present year it was published at No. 135 North
Szechuen Road by the Presbyterian Mission Press which was
established in 1844, but was totally destroyed by the Japanese
in February of this year, who broke into the premises smashing
locks, doors, etc. and seized the files and other documents
therein.    This matter has been the subject of an official
protest by the American Authorities.    The paper is now being
published in a private printing establishment.
        The Board of Directors of the "Tung Wan Pao" are as
follows:-
        The Rev. A.Allison - Kiangyin,
        Mr. O.C.Crawford - Soochow,
        The Rev. W.I.Drummond - Nanking,
        The Rev. H.Kerr Taylor - Tsingkiangfu,
        Dr. Joseph L.King - Changchow,
        The Rev. James Y.Yeh - Hangchow,
        The Rev. Chen Yong Chun - Shanghai,
        The Rev. Bao Chung - Nanking.
        The circulation of the "Tung Wan Pao" last year reached
5,500 copies a week, but, owing to the adverse exchange and the
recent local Shanghai events, this figure has now dropped to
4,800.

主题（全称）.................................................... 《通问报》

制作人......... C.A. J.A.Cook，及 ......... 转呈人......... C.D.I. )

先生，
        《通问报》(            ) （《中华基督教会报》）是一份基督教报纸，由在华活动的美国长老会基督教差会每周在圆明园路19号出版，该报已存在近三十年。直至今年二月第一周，该报一直由成立于1844年的长老会印刷所（Presbyterian Mission Press）在北四川路135号出版，但该印刷所在今年二月被日本人彻底摧毁，日本人闯入 premises，砸坏门锁、门等，并没收了其中的档案和其他文件。此事已成为美国当局正式抗议的主题。目前该报正在一家私人印刷厂出版。
        《通问报》董事会成员如下：-
        A. Allison 牧师 - 江阴，
        O. C. Crawford 先生 - 苏州，
        W. I. Drummond 牧师 - 南京，
        H. Kerr Taylor 牧师 - 清江浦，
        Joseph L. King 博士 - 常州，
        James Y. Yeh 牧师 - 杭州，
        Chen Yong Chun 牧师 - 上海，
        Bao Chung 牧师 - 南京。
        《通问报》去年的发行量达到每周5,500份，但由于汇率不利及近期上海本地事件的影响，这一数字现已降至4,800份。

The English editor is Mr. Allen who is assisted by
Chinese. The policy of the paper is to furnish current
Christian news. The paper is sent all over the world
where Chinese reside, and is subscribed to by churches of
every denomination , as also by many important Chinese hongs,
hospitals, etc.

Attached herewith is the copy of the publication con-
taining the two articles to which the Japanese Authorities
have objected. A translation of these articles is also
attached. The editor of the "Tung Wan Pao" states that the
articles referred to were copied by him from the local Chinese
newspapers "Sin Wan Pao" and "Shun Pao in which they appeared.

（批：File. Several ideas above reported.
If contents of communication to Japanese
have been altered & communicated
to Mr. Allen.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. B. REGISTRY. / 3776 / Special Branch, S. S. Station, / 18 6 32 / Date June 17, 1932）

Subject (in full) The "Tung Wan Pao" (通問報)

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by

Mr. Minami, Chief of the Intelligence Section of the
Japanese Military Attache's Office, requests the courtesy of
the Municipal Police in furnishing him with the following
information regarding the "Tung Wan Pao", a Christian home
paper, published at No. 19 Yuen Min Yuen Road:-
1) The date of establishment and the system of organization
by which the paper is issued.
2) Who are the members?
3) Is the paper issued daily or periodically?
4) The circulation of the paper.
5) What is the policy of the paper?

On June 5, 55 copies of the "Tung Wan Pao", mailed
by the Tung Wan Pao Office, No. 19 Yuen Min Yuen Road, and
addressed to the Christian Association in Changchun and to
several other organizations, were seized by the Police Authorities
there owing to the publication of articles under the heading
"Rapid Progress of the Fascists Movement by the Militarists"
and "the Future of Japanese Diplomacy".

D. S. Umemoto
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：The Tung Wan Pao is not on
sale in the Settlement, endeavours to procure a copy
of it at Bookstores & have been in vain; Inquiries
are being made with a view to obtaining information
as indicated hereon.
C. D. J. Bruce 17/6.
Further report in due course
WS 18:6:32）

主题（全称） 《通问报》 (通問報)

制作人 D. S. Umemoto。转呈人

日本武官处情报科科长南先生（Mr. Minami），请求工部局警务处惠予提供以下关于《通问报》的信息，该报是一份基督教家庭报纸，在圆明园路19号出版：-
1) 创刊日期及该报出版的组织机构体系。
2) 成员有哪些？
3) 该报是日报还是定期刊物？
4) 该报的发行量。
5) 该报的方针是什么？

6月5日，由圆明园路19号《通问报》馆寄出、收件人为长春基督教青年会及其他几个组织的55份《通问报》，因刊登了题为“军阀法西斯运动的迅速发展”和“日本外交的未来”的文章，被当地警察当局扣押。

D. S. Umemoto
D. S.

特别处主管警官。

（批：《通问报》不在租界内销售，试图在书店获取一份副本但未果；正在进行查询，以获取此处所指的信息。
C. D. J. Bruce 6月17日。
适时提交进一步报告
WS 1932年6月18日）

The "Tung Wen Pao" published the following article
in its May issue:-

The following is a Hu Hsin News Agency telegram
from Tokyo dated 18th:-

The Japanese military and naval officers who are
members of the Fascist have assassinated several important
members of the Minseito Cabinet at 1 p.m. October 17,
last year. The persons they intended to assassinate
were Wakatsuki, Shidehara, Inouye and other high officials.
Even Prince Saionji was included. As the plotters
failed to keep their plans secret, the Tokyo Police managed
to secure information of the conspiracy and arrested
about 300 persons. The young officers of the Staff
Headquarters were among the principal promoters of a
secret body. Hiranuma, Vice-President of the Privy Council,
was also in touch with these young officers. The "Kuo Fung"
Tsoen", a Society formed by Hiranuma has for its members,
numerous ex-service men. General Araki, the Minister of
War, is the Chief of the Society, but he lost the support
of the young officers when he obeyed the Cabinet. They
were, still more dissatisfied with him when the Sino-Japanese
Armistice Agreement was signed in Shanghai, because the
signing of such an agreement meant the loss of an opportunity
to distinguish themselves. This was the motive of the
Japanese young officers outrage.

According to the telegram received from Peiping containing
news secured from the Consular Body, Premier Inukai was

《通问报》在其五月刊中发表了以下文章：-

以下是胡信通讯社发自东京的18日电讯：-

身为法西斯成员的日本海陆军军官于去年10月17日下午1点刺杀了民政党内阁的几名重要成员。他们意图刺杀的对象包括若槻、币原、井上及其他高官。甚至连西园寺公也被列入其中。由于策划者未能保密，东京警方设法获得了阴谋的情报，并逮捕了约300人。参谋本部年轻军官是一个秘密团体的主要推动者。枢密院副议长平沼也与这些年轻军官有联系。由平沼组建的“国风粹”（Kuo Fung Tsoen）（音译）协会拥有众多退伍军人作为成员。陆军大臣荒木大将是该协会的首领，但当他服从内阁时，失去了年轻军官的支持。当《淞沪停战协定》在上海签署时，他们对他的不满更加严重，因为签署此类协议意味着失去了立功扬名的机会。这就是日本年轻军官暴行的动机。
